shortDescription: Story map plus journey map duo
longDescription: A twin-map toolkit for product designers. The user story map structures a raw requirement into seven fields, splits the solution into a journey backbone, and grounds each feature in Who/What/When/Why/DoD with MoSCoW priority and release swimlanes, rendered as a self-contained HTML map. The user journey map analyzes a persona-by-scenario experience following the NNGroup model, filling in actions, touchpoints, thoughts, emotion, pain points and opportunities per stage with mandatory fact/hypothesis labeling, plus an emotional curve and moments of truth. Opportunities found in a journey map can be imported as feature drafts in the story map, connecting experience diagnosis directly to requirement breakdown and release planning. State is persisted in a single JSON source of truth, validated and applied atomically by scripts, and re-renderable at any time.
tryPrompts: Map out a raw requirement into a user story map
Analyze this persona's user journey in this scenario
Import journey-map opportunities into the story map
